purpose: Compact mechanism comparison supporting REPORT.md; not a claim of exhaustive project history.

rows.semantic_state: Mutable IdeState around ghc-mod/GHC session; per-file last-good TypecheckedModule cache
rows.incremental_behavior: Reload/typecheck on document change; cached module and plugin data invalidated on new successful module
rows.unsaved_or_broken_input: Mapped temporary files; can answer some queries from last successful module with position remapping
rows.project_environment: Project detection plus hie-bios/hie.yaml; binaries/installations tied to GHC versions
rows.extension_boundary: Plugins execute IdeM actions against cached compiler state

rows.unsaved_or_broken_input: Editor buffers participate as inputs; architecture designed for interactive partial work
rows.project_environment: hie-bios supplies files, dependencies, extensions and GHC session flags
rows.extension_boundary: Compiler-service core plus separate plugins and LSP transport
costs_visible_in_sources: manual hie.yaml often needed for multi-component projects

rows.semantic_state: ghcide compiler-service rules on purpose-built hls-graph
rows.incremental_behavior: Dynamic dependencies and reactive change tracking for minimal in-memory rebuilds
rows.project_environment: Continues to use hie-bios/project cradle boundary
rows.extension_boundary: End-user server plus plugin API/plugins around compiler-service core
rows.historical_change: Recombined ghcide core with HIE integration/plugin experience; later replaced Shake with hls-graph
costs_or_tradeoffs: hls-graph drops persistence and general-purpose filesystem rules
project/compiler environment remains an external prerequisite

alternatives.name: fresh compiler per query
alternatives.cost: repeats expensive semantic work and harms editor latency
alternatives.anneal_use: plausible for authoritative acceptance even if not for every live query

alternatives.name: general persistent incremental engine
alternatives.cost: generality and persistence semantics may exceed or mismatch the editor workload
alternatives.anneal_use: reasonable while dependency contract fits and measured cost is acceptable

alternatives.name: purpose-built in-memory graph
alternatives.benefit: can match live invalidation and scheduling needs closely
alternatives.cost: project owns correctness of invalidation, equality, cancellation and lifetime semantics
alternatives.anneal_use: justify by demonstrated workload/semantic need, not by HLS precedent alone
